full_judgment: 7. It appears from the description of the land scheduled to the plaint of the present suit is measuring an area of 21.99 acres of C.S. plot No.172, 202, 214 and R.S. plot No. 207, 237, 251 appertaining to S.A. Khatian No.103 and R.S. khatian No.126 of Mouza Purba Chandra. It further appears from the land described in the schedule to the plaint of Title Suit No.206 of 1978 that, the same was measuring an area of 12.37 acres out of 29.65 acres of plot No.4, 172, 202 and 214 of C.S. khatin No.50 and S.A. khatian No.103 of Chandra Mouza. That is, the schedules of land of two suits are not identical.
